gate0.decision: Custom TypeScript MCP client cannot obtain an Agent OS session: the Binance authorization server accepts only allowlisted agents. Per prd.md section 2.4 this is the 'stop claiming Agent OS integration' branch for the custom client. Real Agent OS observations remain obtainable through a supported agent session (Claude Code); see routes below.

routes.supported_agent_session: AVAILABLE_PENDING_OPERATOR_SETUP: operator adds the server to an interactive Claude Code session and authenticates; observations are then captured or relayed with explicit provenance
routes.impersonating_a_supported_agent_client_i: REJECTED: circumvents the platform's access control; not used

supported_agent_setup.documented_command: claude mcp add binance-mcp-server --transport http https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic
supported_agent_setup.then: In an interactive Claude Code session run /mcp and complete the Binance consent in the browser. Market-data scope needs no sub-account funding.
supported_agent_setup.product_use: Observations obtained in that session are relayed to the kernel with provenance BINANCE_MCP_VIA_SUPPORTED_AGENT and cross-checked against the kernel's own BINANCE_PUBLIC_REST read; divergence raises an incident.

gate0.self_built_agent_guidance_from_platform: binance.com/agent-os says self-built agents should 'use MCP, APIs and ready-made skills'. No agent registration, whitelisting request, or API-key route into the MCP server was found in the docs, landing page, or launch blog (checked 2026-09-08).

authentication.observed: HTTP 401 with Content-Length 0 on the MCP initialize POST when no bearer token is sent

custom_client_attempt.flow: OAuth 2.1 authorization_code + PKCE S256 as a public client; client_id = HTTPS URL of a hosted client ID metadata document
custom_client_attempt.client_id_metadata_source: docs/oauth-client.json served by GitHub Pages (verified HTTP 200, application/json)
custom_client_attempt.result: Consent page 'Agentic Account Access' rendered, then modal: 'The AI Agent you are using is not currently supported. Please connect using a supported Agent to continue. (3346001-3aa5543c)'. No authorization code was issued; the loopback callback never fired.
custom_client_attempt.interpretation: The authorization server allowlists agent identities. A syntactically valid metadata document from an unknown origin is refused before consent. Scope names remain unobserved.

authentication.platform_statement_vs_observation: Documentation describes market data as public with no auth. Observation: a custom client cannot even open the MCP session. Do not claim unauthenticated or custom-client MCP reads.
authentication.token_storage: spikes/gate0/raw/oauth-tokens.json (gitignored); no token was ever issued

read_market_context.note: Can only be set from a supported-agent session. Record the actual tool name, schema hash, and a sanitized response with timestamps when captured.

spot_testnet.blocker: No dedicated Spot Testnet credentials supplied (BINANCE_TESTNET_API_KEY and BINANCE_TESTNET_API_SECRET absent). Testnet execution is P1 and only follows the qualification table in prd.md section 13.5.

mainnet_public_rest.note: Reachable. Permitted only as separately labelled read-only enrichment (prd.md section 13.4). Never relabelled as MCP. No mainnet trading credential exists or is accepted in v0.1.

model_route.default_until_decided: MODEL_PROVIDER=disabled; REPLAY mode and the offline test suite need no provider
model_route.constraint: Consumer subscriptions (Claude Max, GPT Pro) are development resources, not API credit (prd.md section 16.5). A separately billed provider API key is required for a live model-generated proposal.

local_stack.docker_engine: RUNNING 29.7.2. Docker Desktop 4.88.1 initially crashed on startup because it could not remove its own AF_UNIX socket files (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Docker\run\sailor-ingest.sock, then %LOCALAPPDATA%\docker-secrets-engine\engine.sock; Windows error 1920). Fix: stop Docker Desktop, rename both directories aside, relaunch. Expect a repeat after an unclean shutdown.
